decisions.decision: Pilot capacity is company/department/designation/branch; source has Position with configurable structural quantity. Add stable Position and effective-dated allocation; migrate links and reconcile before enabling new routing. Do not equate one designation to one position.

Older formula omits reservations; later §5 includes them. Preserve atomic reservations. Resolve warning/block switch and exact exception authority; record requested vs approved quantities and no self-double-count during amendments.

Source includes special HR-sector/CEO cases; pilot blocks direct/delegated requester self-approval and skips normal own steps. Agree a decision table for requester, beneficiary, creator and principal. Repeated authority needs a distinct decision step and a replay-safe command.

decisions.topic: Hierarchy at submission versus changes later
decisions.decision: Resolve route from effective hierarchy, then freeze that revision’s steps and reviewed payloads. A later org change must use an explicit reroute/version event, not silently replace prior authority.

decisions.topic: Person versus application and shared phones
decisions.decision: Pilot unique key uses opening + email/phone. Add Person identity and application links; warn/review potential duplicates. Preserve verified matches and historical applicant IDs; no automatic merge based only on a shared phone.

Older heading requires salaries/around-minimum authority; later decisions make expected salary optional and recruiter authority exactly at grade minimum. Reconcile config/examples against latest source code and HR decisions before thresholds are enabled.

Source labels and later decisions differ; contract content is marked preliminary. Treat templates, dates and rates as versioned HR/legal inputs. Build configurable case workflows using synthetic examples; do not certify the source’s legal statements.

Source requires tamper evidence and erasure of personal payloads. Define supported redaction evidence, retention holds, backup expiry and restoration replay before calling the audit immutable or privacy-complete.

Translate the source’s Gmail/OTP/CEO trusted-device requirements into a supported Frappe identity design. Standard Frappe authentication is not proof of exact source parity. Record any deliberate security-equivalent replacement.

Full reference business behavior includes source-deferred items as explicit work. Delivery/estimator/Odoo integration and a complete payroll/attendance rollout are separate from this recruitment-and-employment reference; installed modules do not expand accepted scope automatically.
